name: electron-blocks
description: Timeblocks desktop shell — loads the react-web-calendar build in the main process

scripts.sync:web: npm --prefix ../react-web-calendar run build:electron && rm -rf web-build && cp -R ../react-web-calendar/build web-build
scripts.sync:web:dev: npm --prefix ../react-web-calendar run build:dev && rm -rf web-build && cp -R ../react-web-calendar/build web-build
scripts.build: npm run compile && npm run sync:web && electron-builder --mac && electron-builder --win
scripts.build:dev: npm run compile && npm run sync:web:dev && electron-builder --mac && electron-builder --win
scripts.build:mac: npm run compile && npm run sync:web && electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:mac:dev: npm run compile && npm run sync:web:dev && electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:win: npm run compile && npm run sync:web && electron-builder --win
scripts.build:win:dev: npm run compile && npm run sync:web:dev && electron-builder --win
